details: Vrchat is a game that has a very versatile player base that over the years has created its own “Community” with a mixture of different interests and cultures. It has overtime grown into something with the potential of becoming something bigger along the lines of the movie “ready player one”. I’ve been a DJ at one of Vrchats many club worlds for quite some time, and I have seen the club community grow as more players come to VRC. A big thing that I noticed within Vrchats club scene is that there is a lot of real money being spent within this community whether it is being spent in (Dances, tips, and or prizes won). What makes this such an issue is that these are being sent through separate apps such as Cash App or PayPal. Leaving the chance for fraud or sending the money to the wrong accounts. This problem is the reason why I came with the idea of VRC making it’s own currency. Vrchats ability to makes its own in game currency can both increase the market value and player base of its game. This currency can be along the lines of Fortnite’s vbucks or to something that is strictly Vrchats own crypto currency. This is something I know would need time to be made into a working feature that can and will be used by everyone within the game. This will be an in game currency can be withdrawn for real money or kept in the game if the player chooses to do so. This feature that would be used all over the game, will give players an opportunity to make a living at one point through your game through selling skins, worlds, services and etc. directly through VRC. And can even have a transfer fee that Vrchat can hold as percentage. This is a big possibility that I know will have new safety and age guidelines as well as new Tech support lines. This is one feature I know can bring increased business as popularity grows within the gaming community and curiosity peaks interests. Please give this a thought.
title: Make the game it’s own unique place
